# Andrew Yip — UX/UI Designer & Developer

> Andrew Yip is a UX/UI designer and developer based in Vancouver, BC, Canada.
> Originally from Hong Kong, he completed a postgraduate program in Web and Mobile App Design & Development at Langara College before building his career in British Columbia.
> He specialises in product design, design systems, landing pages, and front-end development for SaaS and enterprise companies.
> Available for freelance projects and full-time roles.

- [Portfolio & Work](https://andrewthyip.com/portfolio/): Overview of all case studies and client work
- [Services](https://andrewthyip.com/services/): Services offered, process/workflow, client work examples, and testimonials — for businesses looking to have a website designed and built
- [About Andrew Yip](https://andrewthyip.com/about/): Background, work philosophy, career timeline, skills, and testimonials
- [Contact](https://andrewthyip.com/contact/): Contact form for project inquiries, freelance work, and full-time opportunities
- [Yocale Case Study](https://andrewthyip.com/work/yocale/): GTM design system — 5.15% CTR lift, 40% bounce rate reduction, 22.5% download lift
- [Delta Controls Case Study](https://andrewthyip.com/work/delta/): Enterprise intranet redesign — navigation reduced from 4–6 clicks to 2–3 clicks, 15% engagement increase
- [Ant Equipment Group Case Study](https://andrewthyip.com/work/ant/): Brand and web design — 1,000+ monthly visitors, 80% engagement lift
- [Crowd Ease Case Study](https://andrewthyip.com/work/crowd-ease/): Capstone Award-winning restaurant and event management mobile app (Langara College 2023, selected by audience vote)
